title: MCP server manifest
description: A publisher-authored description of one MCP server. The loader validates against this shape, then applies the rules in src/validate.js.

name.description: Reverse-DNS identifier. The prefix before the slash is the namespace the publisher must own.

version.description: Exact semver. A range cannot be resolved by a loader that never sees the artifact.

title.description: Human-readable name for market listings. Defaults to the local part of name.

category.description: Preferred market category. When absent the host classifies the entry from its name and description.

categories.description: Ordered category hints; the first entry wins, same as category.

verifiedBy.description: How the namespace claim is proven. Anything other than a listed mechanism is treated as self-asserted.

domains.description: Additional hosts allowed to serve this server's endpoint.

command.description: Required for stdio. An MCP server is an external process; it cannot infer a launcher.

url.description: Required for http. May contain {variable} placeholders in the path only.

env.description: Values may reference ${ENV_NAME}, which the host resolves to a prompt or an environment variable.

headers.description: Never templated with {variable}. Only ${ENV_NAME} references are allowed.

packages.description: Every entry must be pinned. The launch command must still reference one of these identifiers.

permissions.description: Declared up front so a host can refuse an undeclared server. Missing means UNDECLARED.

variables.description: Substituted into the URL path only. Never into a header.
